# Phrase structure

Pitches are MIDI numbers, 60 = middle C. Onsets are slots 0 to 15 of a sixteenth grid, so slot 4 is beat 2; lengths are in beats. Tiers: M1 is needed in a first test set, M2 has one or two sources or is a jazz or world idiom, M3 is single-source, inferred or theory only. Tags: `source states`, `measured`, `derived` (our computation on public data), `inferred` (our reading), `snippet` (a search excerpt), `single source`, `proposal` (a policy, not a fact). Source ids are listed in `dictionary/sources.json`.

## Phrase structure

| Word | Id | Rule | Meaning | Tier | Tag | Sources |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| phrase length (phrase lengths) | `phrase.phrase-length` | changes every 4 or 8 or 16 or 32 bars, on bars 1 + k times that | Dance sections run 8, 16 or 32 bars. Trance changes layers every 4, 8, 16 or 32 bars, and psytrance leads change every 8. Changes fall on bars 5, 9, 13 and so on (every 4) or 9, 17 (every 8). | M1 | source states | guides |
| repetition with variation (variation) | `phrase.repetition-with-variation` | at least 50 % of bars repeat an earlier bar; at most 75 % of bars repeat an earlier bar; for at least 4 bars | Keep 3 of 4 bars and change the 4th. Drop or lift one note every 4 or 8 bars, mute the last sixteenth every 4 bars, or skip one offbeat before a chord change. | M1 | source states | guides |
| build | `phrase.build` | none | A section of about 8 bars (4 to 16) that rises in density, from quarters to eighths to sixteenths, with a velocity ramp. It rests on search excerpts and is not checked against a full source. | M3 | snippet | guides |
| drop | `phrase.drop` | none | The payoff section, 8 to 16 bars long. One source says 16 to 32. | M3 | source states | guides |
| breakdown | `phrase.breakdown` | none | A section that removes kick, bass and percussion and keeps pad, lead and arp. It lasts 16 to 32 bars or 8 to 16. | M3 | source states | guides |
| intro and outro (intro, outro) | `phrase.intro-and-outro` | none | The opening and closing sections, 8 to 16 bars each. It rests on search excerpts and is not checked against a full source. | M3 | snippet | guides |
| AABA | `phrase.aaba` | none | A 32-bar form of four 8-bar parts: the theme twice, a contrast, then the theme again. | M3 | single source | guides |
